coverage_notes: Two Anthropic model launch articles found for January-June 2025: February 24 Claude 3.7 Sonnet and May 22 Claude 4 (Opus 4 and Sonnet 4).

Claude 3.7 scores were transcribed from three chart/table images in its primary launch article. Claude 4 article includes a SWE-bench chart plus textual and appendix scores. Its text refers to TAU-bench and other extended-thinking benchmarks but does not expose all numeric scores in the web text; those are omitted rather than guessed.
AIME year is unspecified in the Claude 4 appendix and is kept as AIME; the Claude 3.7 chart explicitly says AIME 2024.
